revision_budget: Initial P1349 contract. One revision remains only for a newly measured contract failure class. This authority runs focal=0, full=0, ptrace=0 and candidate=0.

measured_blocker.measurement: The P1348 decisive focal returned 25 records and stopped at X06. X06 produced the exact planned integration blocker after freshness commit; X15 independently exposed the historical NameError and restoration evidence; X14 did not terminate until KeyboardInterrupt. Regressions, replays, controls, repeat, reverse, full and candidate runs remained zero.
measured_blocker.causal_failure: P1348 put planned adapter/freshness blockers in the same result and release path as semantic mutation classifications, and it had no bounded parent supervisor able to distinguish checker-owned timely rejection from an external timeout kill.
measured_blocker.repair_hypothesis: Separate meta_result from classification_result, execute X06 and X15 as two disposable-process meta gates before any scored focal, make every non-allowlisted blocker terminal, and supervise each dangerous case with monotonic deadlines, pidfds, a dedicated session/process group, registered descendants and mandatory kill-and-reap cleanup.

normative_composition.failed_baseline: P1348 is composed as an immutable failed transport baseline. Its P1347/P1346/P1345 semantics, exact protected corpus identities, parent transaction, consumable freshness, reason precedence, TRACEEXEC|TRACEEXIT|EXITKILL lifecycle, real-image authentication, answer-free DAG and strict canonical JSON remain normative except for the result-domain and execution-supervision repairs stated here.
preserved: P1348 protected inputs and all transitive P1347/P1346/P1345 semantic, source and runtime obligations
parent-owned PID/pidfd/waitid/waitpid/pipe authority transaction and append-only freshness commit
exact reason-code precedence and one EXEC plus one EXIT event under TRACEEXEC|TRACEEXIT|EXITKILL
real sealed-FD loaded-image authentication, external authority root and answer-free mutation DAG
strict duplicate-free canonical JSON, single authenticated opaque Unknown and zero transport Unknown
replaced_only: X06/X15 placement in scored focal and release logic
X14 acceptance without timely checker termination

result_domain_separation.rule: meta_result, classification_result and integration_blocker are three disjoint closed schemas. No record may satisfy or embed more than one domain. Domain dispatch occurs from the invoked API and process channel before interpreting payload fields.

meta_result.meaning: Reports whether one closed allowlisted meta experiment observed its exact blocker, state and restoration postconditions. It never classifies a semantic mutation and never enters mutation score.

classification_result.meaning: Reports only a checker-owned semantic classification after authenticated completion. It cannot encode adapter/supervisor failure or planned meta success.

integration_blocker.meaning: Terminal control-plane failure. It never counts as a killed mutation, valid negative, control pass or semantic Unknown.

result_domain_separation.canonicality: Every schema rejects duplicate, unknown, missing or out-of-order keys and noncanonical encodings before domain-specific interpretation.

planned_meta_gate.process_model: Each allowlisted meta case runs in its own newly forked or spawned disposable executor process, with a new parent-owned registry, new session identity, new challenge and no state carried to the other case or to focal execution. The supervisor destroys and reaps the complete process tree before accepting the meta_result.

x06.injection_point: Inject failure only after the exact freshness identity has atomically transitioned PENDING to CONSUMED.
required_postconditions: a second begin/acceptance for the same identity is rejected
registry commit ordinal and digest remain unchanged after the injected failure
all patches restore by object identity
executor and every descendant are reaped
x06.pass_rule: Only the exact observation plus every postcondition becomes meta_result PASS. No blocker record is forwarded into classification or scoring.

x15.injection_point: Inject the historical original_open NameError at its frozen adapter boundary in a fresh disposable process.
required_postconditions: no classification and no reason_code are emitted
the operation-local original_open object is captured before patching
restoration attempted and completed in finally
checker.os.open identity before and after is exactly equal
executor and every descendant are reaped
x15.pass_rule: Only the exact observation plus every postcondition becomes meta_result PASS. The historical exception is evidence for the meta gate, never a semantic violation.

planned_meta_gate.acceptance: meta_tests_total equals 2 and meta_tests_passed equals 2 before X14 or any other focal case may start.
planned_meta_gate.outside_allowlist: Any integration blocker outside these two exact case IDs and exact injected boundaries is terminal. A wrong blocker, wrong phase, wrong verdict, missing postcondition, leaked process or cleanup/restoration failure in X06/X15 is terminal meta failure, not an allowlisted success.

supervisor_contract.unit: Every dangerous operation, including ptrace, second exec, additional fork, detach and syscall monkeypatch, executes in one dedicated executor process supervised by its parent. No executor is reused across cases.
launch: Create dedicated stdout, stderr and control pipes before spawn.
Executor calls setsid so its PID is the session ID and process-group ID; parent records the exact positive spawn PID and immediately opens a retained pidfd for it.
Parent records pipe endpoint fstat identities and closes all opposite endpoints.
No case mutation begins until parent has authenticated the executor PID, pidfd, session and process group and acknowledged readiness over the control pipe.

deadlines.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC through monotonic_ns only; wall clock is forbidden

supervisor_contract.descendant_registration: Before a child or grandchild may continue past its creation stop or readiness barrier, executor sends PID, PPID, SID, PGID and /proc starttime on the control pipe. Supervisor authenticates membership, opens and retains that process pidfd, records the tuple, then ACKs. An unregistered, continued, substituted or reused PID is a terminal WORKER_AUTHORITY or SUPERVISOR_PROTOCOL blocker according to phase.
normal_completion: waitid(P_PIDFD, executor_pidfd, WEXITED|WNOWAIT) and waitpid(executor_pid, 0) agree
all registered descendants have terminal pidfd observations and are reaped
stdout and stderr reach EOF and exact framing/limits pass
patch identity and temporary-resource restoration pass
timeout_cleanup: At supervisor deadline, mark SUPERVISOR_TIMEOUT before interpreting partial output
send SIGTERM through every retained live pidfd and to the exact process group
after term_grace_ms send SIGKILL through remaining live pidfds and to the process group
wait/reap executor and every registered descendant within kill_and_reap_deadline_ms
verify no live session/process-group member, close pipes/pidfds and remove per-case /dev/shm resources
supervisor_contract.timeout_result: If external supervisor intervention is required, emit integration_blocker with blocker_code SUPERVISOR_TIMEOUT. It is terminal, outside mutation score and cannot be converted to Violated, Unknown, meta PASS or a valid negative.
supervisor_contract.interrupts: KeyboardInterrupt, signal interruption, orphan, zombie, incomplete pipe EOF, incomplete cleanup or inability to prove an empty process tree is a terminal integration blocker and never a mutation reason.
supervisor_contract.authority: Only parent syscall observations and retained descriptors authorize process state. Executor stdout, adapter objects, corpus data and projected JSON cannot supply PID, pidfd, session, group, deadline or reap authority.

x14_termination_contract.checker_obligation: Under TRACEEXEC|TRACEEXIT|EXITKILL, checker must observe the second PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC for the retained pidfd-backed tracee, reject it, terminate and reap the tracee and all registered descendants, close streams and return before checker_deadline_ms.
x14_termination_contract.violated_rule: X14 is classification_result Violated with reason_code PROBE_AUTHORITY only when the checker itself completes the rejection and cleanup within checker_deadline_ms and the executor then satisfies every normal supervisor completion predicate before supervisor_deadline_ms.
x14_termination_contract.blocker_rule: If the checker does not terminate by checker_deadline_ms, or the external supervisor signals any process, or cleanup/status/framing is incomplete, X14 is integration_blocker SUPERVISOR_TIMEOUT or the earlier exact supervisor blocker. It contributes neither numerator nor denominator.
x14_termination_contract.forbidden_credit: A KeyboardInterrupt, externally killed hang, partial output, inferred second exec or post-timeout synthetic result cannot establish Violated/PROBE_AUTHORITY.

classification_counts_and_score.score_formula: mutation_score = focal_correctly_violated / focal_valid_negatives, computed only after focal_valid_negatives > 0 and all released classification slices finish
classification_counts_and_score.separation: X06 and X15 are absent from focal_valid_negatives and focal_correctly_violated. Controls, meta results, blockers, Unknown and incomplete/timed-out cases never enter either mutation-score operand.
classification_counts_and_score.inherited_base: The P1348 first slice has 25 records; removing X06 and X15 leaves 23 classification focals. With the inherited 39 P1347 focal negatives and 181 P1346 replay negatives, the base denominator before any independently frozen P1349 supervisor variants is 243.
classification_counts_and_score.new_variant_formula: focal_valid_negatives = 243 + count(exact independently frozen P1349 classification variants). Each added variant has one unique ID and one expected exact reason; no variant may intentionally require external timeout as its passing observation.
classification_counts_and_score.reporting: Reports print all five counts and the score as distinct fields. They must not report a combined pass total or count an allowlisted meta observation as a killed mutation.

adapter_contract.dispatch: case must belong to exactly one frozen domain before mutation. exercise_meta accepts only the two allowlisted meta IDs. exercise_focal rejects X06, X15 and every ID absent from exact_ids before invoking checker code.
adapter_contract.exception_boundary: exercise_meta recognizes only the exact deliberately injected blocker at the exact allowlisted phase and validates its postconditions before returning meta_result. Any other exception in either API becomes a terminal integration_blocker; exercise_focal never catches an exception into classification_result.
adapter_contract.no_fabrication: Adapter cannot author expectations, classifications, reasons, process observations, registry transitions, ptrace events, deadlines, cleanup evidence or verdicts. It transports independently frozen attacks and raw checker observations only.
adapter_contract.restoration: Every patched callable/object is captured in the operation scope, installed inside try, restored in finally and identity-compared before result emission. Restoration failure is terminal.

gate_order_exact: G01 protected-input freeze and canonical contract spec/binding/receipt
G02 independent oracle and adversary authorship from exact contract hashes
G03 adapter authorship only after both independent freezes
G04 disposable-process meta gate X06 then X15; require 2/2
G05 X14 plus independently frozen supervisor classification variants
G06 remaining 22 P1348 classification focals after excluding X06/X15 and after X14 is not rerun
G08 181 P1346 replay negatives and eleven controls
G09 fresh normal, repeat and reverse schedules with separate process supervision
G10 accept exact reasons, focal score 1.0, zero regressions, zero unexpected blockers and exactly one authenticated opaque Unknown
G12 limited preseal only after every earlier gate
gates_budget_and_stop.release_rule: Each gate consumes only the immediately preceding frozen receipts and releases the next gate only after exact success. A meta FAIL, unexpected blocker, timeout, survivor, reason mismatch, regression, protected drift or cleanup ambiguity stops the chain immediately.
static_gates: strict duplicate-free canonical JSON and closed schemas
all protected and authored SHA-256 pins
Python source parse/compile without candidate execution
gates_budget_and_stop.stop: Two revisions without causal gain, any blocker outside the exact X06/X15 meta observation boundary, score below 1.0, reason relaxation, regression, supervisor timeout, process leak, protected drift, transport Unknown, static-gate failure or scope expansion blocks P1349 without waiver.
gates_budget_and_stop.forbidden_progress: No full corpus, RED, productive candidate, 38-capsule implementation or final certificate is authorized by P1349.

scope.claim: Only the P1349 discriminatory refinement that separates meta validation from semantic classification and makes dangerous-case termination and cleanup parent-supervised and bounded.

closed_world.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. P1349 composes P1348 only as a failed immutable baseline and changes only result-domain separation, planned meta gating and bounded parent supervision. Mixed result schemas, non-disposable meta execution, blocker-as-score, external-kill credit, unregistered descendants, unbounded waits or gate reordering is invalid.
